posts.title: Book report - The Black Swan and the Art of Living With the Unpredictable
posts.description: Every once in a while you read a book that doesn’t just give you new ideas - it gives you new language for things you’ve always felt but never quite managed to articulate. The Black Swan by Nassim Nicholas Taleb did exactly that for me.
